main_upside_drivers: Semiconductor position — earnings acceleration could contribute +5–8% to portfolio return in the upside scenario
Cloud infrastructure position — margin durability confirmation would improve range and confidence
Valuation re-rating across growth positions if rate environment becomes more favorable
main_downside_drivers: Rate sensitivity — three of six positions have high valuation multiples exposed to rate increases
Earnings revision risk — two positions have guidance that has not been reaffirmed for the next quarter
Concentration — semiconductor and cloud positions together represent 47% of portfolio weight
portfolio_scenario.concentration_sensitivity: Portfolio range is sensitive to valuation assumptions and concentration. The semiconductor and cloud positions together account for 47% of weight. A bear case outcome for either position would move the portfolio downside range by 3–6 percentage points.
portfolio_scenario.valuation_sensitivity: Three positions have EV/Revenue or P/E multiples above historical average levels. A 15% multiple compression across these positions would reduce the base case range by approximately 4 percentage points.
evidence_gaps: Forward guidance reaffirmation outstanding for two positions ahead of next earnings season
Margin durability evidence is incomplete for three of six positions
Competitive position evidence is weak for one position — requires evidence refresh

assumptions.description: Semiconductor position earnings grow 20–28% in the base case, driven by data centre and AI infrastructure demand. Bear case assumes 5–8% growth on inventory correction.
Rate environment holds broadly stable in the base case. A rate surprise upward would compress multiples for three high-multiple positions. Downside range could widen if margin assumptions weaken.
Aggregate operating margin improvement of 0.5–1.5 percentage points across the portfolio in the base case. Several holdings require evidence refresh before confidence can improve.

evidence_items.description: Current macro context: central bank holding rates; market pricing 1–2 cuts over the next 12 months. Rate sensitivity is the primary driver of the downside scenario.
Semiconductor position: last two quarters beat earnings estimates by 3–5%. Revenue growth accelerating. Guidance maintained.

change_triggers.description: Next earnings season — four of six portfolio positions report within the next six weeks. Key test for margin and revenue growth assumptions across multiple holdings.
change_triggers.monitoring_note: Prioritise semiconductor and cloud infrastructure positions first. Monitor margin commentary specifically.

change_triggers.description: Central bank rate decision — any surprise above or below current market pricing would affect valuation multiples for three positions.
change_triggers.monitoring_note: A rate surprise upward of 25bps or more would require scenario revision for the three high-multiple positions.
